Junior SOC Analyst
Location: Vancouver, BC (Hybrid)

About us
Northwind Security protects credit unions across Western Canada.

What you'll do
- Monitor alerts in Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel, triage incidents and escalate.
- Write Python scripts to automate log analysis.
- Document investigations clearly for the wider team.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity or a related field
- 0-2 years of experience in a SOC or IT role
- Familiarity with SIEM tools, MITRE ATT&CK and incident response
- Linux and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS)
- Strong communication skills

Nice to have
- Security+ or CySA+
- Experience with AWS and Docker

Salary: $60,000 - $72,000 CAD per year
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada. We are unable to provide sponsorship.
